subject: Boston Avenue Bikeway Design
overview: The commission met to determine minimum acceptable bicycle infrastructure for the Boston Avenue corridor alongside new Tufts University construction. Members voted on prioritized roadway cross-sections and established a working group to coordinate advocacy with the city and Tufts.

items.title: Boston Avenue Infrastructure Review and Design Parameters
items.summary: Members and community guests reviewed street width constraints, parking demand, and ongoing studies related to Tufts University dormitory construction along Boston Avenue.

items.title: Motion on Hybrid Bikeway Configuration
items.summary: A motion to formally endorse a hybrid design—featuring a protected bike lane on one side and a shared travel lane on the other—over the status quo configuration failed.

items.title: Boston Avenue Design Recommendations
items.summary: The commission approved a prioritized list of three design alternatives for Boston Avenue, leading with protected bike lanes and north-side parking removal as the preferred option, followed by two parking-protected variations.

items.title: Boston Avenue Working Group
items.summary: The commission voted to create an ad hoc working group to draft an advocacy letter and coordinate next steps with city officials and Tufts University representatives.
